in_marathi.name: Sharvikaarya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of wisdom and knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvikaarya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess Sharvikaarya is a manifestation of the goddess Saraswati, who is the embodiment of wisdom, knowledge, art, and learning. The name Sharvikaarya comes from the Sanskrit words 'sharva' which means 'shining' and 'karya' which means 'work' or 'deed'. Thus, Sharvikaarya can be translated as 'Goddess of Shining Work' or 'Goddess of Brilliant Deeds'.
